description: Dynamic irrigation recommendation rules per crop and growth stage. Soil moisture is expressed as a percentage (0-100).

messages.irrigation_required: Soil moisture for {crop} at {stage} stage is {moisture}%, below the minimum required {min_moisture}%. Irrigation is recommended: approximately {amount_mm} mm of water.
messages.irrigation_optional: Soil moisture for {crop} at {stage} stage is {moisture}%, slightly below ideal ({ideal_moisture}%). Light irrigation of {amount_mm} mm is optional.
messages.no_irrigation_needed: Soil moisture for {crop} at {stage} stage is {moisture}%, which is sufficient. No irrigation needed at this time.
